baseline.policy: freeze working modules; extend through adapters and data-driven taxonomy

change_policy: Do not rebuild the whole app to fix one module.
Freeze working modules and replace only the module under change.
Do not remove or rename an existing data path without a migration plan.
Presets are recommendations only; they never permanently remove capabilities.
Unknown future fields, location types, route links and classifications must be addable without rewriting neighboring modules.
Usability and readable mobile typography are release requirements.
Every release response must include exact upload filenames and post-upload GitHub Pages URLs.
Map display/search failure must not block location input; provider fallback and direct map placement are required.

location_contract.rule: camp lodging/training/base locations are not forced into checkpoint semantics

route_connection_contract.rule: route connection is optional and independent from checkpoint/QUEST

map_provider_contract.note: Google Geocoding REQUEST_DENIED must not blank the map editor

regression_requirements: v20 MAP CORE file is not modified by this release.
LIVE_EVENT_PLATFORM data paths are not renamed.
BGM is added as a sibling module, not embedded into MAP/QUEST core.
v1-v4 IndexedDB events migrate without deleting existing values.
new events do not inherit another event map automatically.
location search permission failure still allows visible map and direct placement.
camp can store meeting/lodging/training/base as separate locations.
routeConnections do not turn locations into checkpoints.
quest preset exposes detailed structure, arrival and experience controls.
public preview remains available from top bar and STEP 5.

release.purpose: Make map input resilient, promote BGM to a first-class module, support multi-location camps and generic point-to-point routes, and expose the previously missing detailed QUEST configuration without coupling modules.
